description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity for an Android app demonstrating tab navigation with fragments. It includes tab setup, a custom tab listener, and inner fragment classes for displaying simple TextView content.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing tabbed navigation and fragment transactions.

classes.name: MainActivity.InstantiatingTabListener
classes.description: Handles tab selection events by instantiating or attaching fragments.

classes.name: MainActivity.PhotosFragment
classes.description: Displays a centered text for the 'photos' tab.

classes.name: MainActivity.VideosFragment
classes.description: Displays a centered text for the 'videos' tab.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up tabs with associated fragments.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles tab selection, instantiates and adds fragments as needed.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Detaches the fragment when tab is unselected.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: No operation when reselecting an active tab.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates a centered TextView displaying the tab title for each fragment.
